research_question: Can large 15:20 stock moves relative to a sufficiently broad PIT SIC peer group mean-revert after a contemporaneous volume shock?

data_contract.source_features: causal broad-PIT fixed-15:20 cache from section 6.227
data_contract.universe: quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility and ADV20 >= 10m; price >= 5; absolute opening gap <= 30%
data_contract.signal_clock: all price, volume, SIC medians, and ranks use rows known at the exact 15:20 entry; no post-entry field enters selection
data_contract.sector_definition: PIT Polygon SIC description; UNKNOWN is allowed only when it has at least ten eligible names that date
data_contract.sector_residual: stock 09:30-to-15:20 return minus same-date SIC median return
data_contract.market_residual: stock 09:30-to-15:20 return minus same-date eligible-universe median return
data_contract.missing_exit: reuse the pre-registered section 6.227 post-selection policy: first later regular-session bar within five calendar days; otherwise conservative 100% leg-notional loss; no drop or refill

variants.name: sector_resid_reversal_overnight
variants.rule: abs sector residual >= 2%; volume ratio >= 1.2; trade opposite residual
variants.rank: absolute sector residual times capped volume ratio

variants.name: sector_resid_reversal_next1520
variants.rule: abs sector residual >= 2%; volume ratio >= 1.2; trade opposite residual
variants.rank: absolute sector residual times capped volume ratio

variants.name: sector_exhaustion_overnight
variants.rule: base sector residual rule plus late return opposite residual and abs late return >= 0.3%
variants.rank: absolute sector residual times absolute late return times capped volume ratio

variants.name: double_resid_reversal_overnight
variants.rule: abs sector residual >= 1.5%; abs market residual >= 2%; residual signs agree; volume ratio >= 1.2; trade opposite sector residual
variants.rank: absolute sector residual times absolute market residual times capped volume ratio

variants.name: extreme_volume_reversal_overnight
variants.rule: abs sector residual >= 1.5%; volume ratio >= 1.8; trade opposite residual
variants.rank: absolute sector residual times capped volume ratio

portfolio.selection: up to three names per side with matched long/short counts; rank after exact-entry filtering and fully refill each side
portfolio.weight: 10% current NAV absolute weight per leg; maximum 0.6x gross
portfolio.sic_cap: maximum one ticker per SIC per side

development_gate.winner: highest base-cost Sharpe then CAGR among passers

multiple_testing_policy: Exactly five frozen rows. This family is not the mechanical sign reversal of every failed continuation trade. No post-result threshold, clock, horizon, rank, direction, or position-count changes.
production_policy: A validation pass permits further audit only, not production PASS.
